crm_field_note: work_profile and 1099_income_history are sent only by the 1099 page; income_profile and self_employment_history only by the other two. All must exist. A2P/10DLC: sms_consent and sms_marketing_consent are yes/no; sms_consent_timestamp is ISO-8601 and is only stamped when consent was given; sms_consent_text is the verbatim disclosure as rendered. sms_consent_ip is stamped server-side by the CRM endpoint from x-forwarded-for, scoped to payloads that carry sms_consent so the main-site contact form is unaffected. THE CONTACT PAGE posts six fields no other form sends: full_name, what_is_your_primary_source_of_income, property_state, est_loan_amt, loan_type and tell_us_about_your_situation. They were declared only at routes[].fields until 17 September 2026, so provisioning from this list alone created every scenario field and none of the contact ones. They are in both places now; this list is the full one. Note also that full_name is NOT one of crm_native_contact_fields (firstName, email, phone) — the contact form sends the whole name as a custom field. BOTH CALCULATOR PAGES also post loan_type from 18 September 2026: an optional "which loan type would you like to discuss" question, added by owner direction. It deliberately reuses the contact page's key AND its exact nine option values, so no new GoHighLevel field and no new vocabulary are needed — a blank value simply means the visitor skipped it. The DFW calculator build fails if the two option sets ever diverge or if the field is made required.
analytics_note: Meta Pixel 1928662551345817 is wired on all landing pages; scenario_form_success maps to the standard Lead event and phone_click to Contact. GA4 G-2LMXT6BVCY is installed on all landing pages and verified receiving events; scenario_form_success still needs marking as a key event in GA4. Events are also pushed to window.dataLayer for a future GTM container. Event list reconciled against the code on 2 September 2026: every entry is fired by either a JS call or a data-track / data-pageview-event attribute in markup, and nothing fired is missing. hero_primary_cta_click and hero_secondary_cta_click were removed — these pages place the scenario form directly in the hero, so there are no hero CTA buttons to instrument. The nine per-product pageview events for consolidated products were removed on 8 September 2026: a page fires one pageview event, so those nine could never fire and would have produced nine GA4 reports stuck at zero.
calculator_field_note: The 13 calc_* fields are sent only by the calculator route. calc_snapshot_json is a single JSON string holding the full input/result set plus the calculator version and the MI mode in force, so a scenario can be reconstructed exactly as the visitor saw it. calc_notes is visitor free text. All must exist in GHL before form_mode is set to live, or the scenario silently drops and only name, email and phone arrive. Calculator analytics deliberately carry no dollar amounts: LTV is banded and figures are omitted, because these events reach GA4 and the Meta Pixel. The calculator route sends program_interest EMPTY by design: a visitor modelling a payment has not indicated a product, and inferring one would be a guess. Calculator leads therefore route on the crm_tag "calculator" via a dedicated workflow, not on program_interest. The calculator carries no geographic tag either, being a national page.
program_interest_note: The ten program pages added 2026-09-03 introduce new program_interest values: asset_only, asset_utilization, bridge, buy_before_you_sell, construction, dscr_investor, profit_loss, rsu_bonus_commission, seller_financing_more, spec_construction, jumbo, second_home. profit_loss and asset_utilization were already in use; the rest are new. A lead carries its value whether or not a GoHighLevel workflow routes it, so routing and assignment need to exist before these pages take traffic. POSTED BUT PREVIOUSLY UNLISTED (added 17 September 2026, verified against the built pages): general (DFW market home), no_ratio, super_jumbo, home_loan_options, dscr (DFW; Austin still posts dscr_investor), complex_compensation (DFW RSU page) and not_sure (DFW contact page). A workflow keyed to rsu_bonus_commission will not fire for DFW leads. Which name survives is a CRM decision, not a site one. RSU CONFLICT RESOLVED 18 September 2026: both RSU pages now post rsu_bonus_commission as tag and program_interest. The DFW page previously posted complex_compensation per section 11 of the RSU handoff; the owner decided the DFW page adopts the value Austin already used, so one workflow now serves both markets. complex_compensation is no longer posted by any page.

build_gates.note: Automated checks that run against this build. Every one has been made to fail on purpose at least once, because a gate nobody has seen fail is not known to work. Generated by scratchpad/update-manifest-gates.js from build-all.js, and only written when the invariants passed.

blocking.checks: each clone carries the Self-Employed dropdown; nothing links off the DFW suite; every live page exists; each Austin page has its questionnaire, meta description, JSON-LD, working mobile nav, no ratings in schema and is not noindex; the market home keeps its nav geometry
every internal href and in-page anchor on every built page resolves — to a page on disk, a live React route, or an .htaccess redirect. Assets must exist as files.
blocking.measured: 1810 internal links, 65 in-page anchors, across 33 pages
blocking.why: verify-routes.sh checks the routes we know about; it cannot see a typo in one card href, because the route it should have pointed at is fine. The builders rewrite hrefs in bulk, so a bad needle in a repointing pass lands everywhere at once.
blocking.on_failure: the build fails and names every affected page

blocking.checks: each builder asserts its own edits landed — a MISS is fatal, so a needle that stops matching stops the build rather than silently producing an unedited page
every referenced image is present in upload/; all pages are in the staging indexing state; the shell schema carries no aggregateRating and is still valid JSON
after flipping, re-reads every page and confirms its robots and googlebot meta match the mode and robots.txt

reporting.checks: duplicate ids, dangling ARIA references, label/for mismatches, analytics events that disagree with this manifest, CRM fields a form posts that this manifest does not declare, one manifest row per page with matching pageview events, sitemap entries that are permanently noindex, and the eyebrow contrast rule present and identical in both stylesheets
reporting.severity: HIGH findings are data-loss or wrong-answer class

reporting.checks: every referenced image exists, every hero class has a CSS rule, and no DFW photograph carries more than two pages
every submitting page lands in exactly one CRM branch under the documented form_type conditions

run against a live host: canonical URLs, URL variants collapsing, retired-route 301s, intermediate 404s, source docs not served, indexing state, the Austin static pages, and that every image a page references is actually served (including CSS backgrounds)
reporting.note: not run at build time — it needs a host. Run it immediately after upload, before any redirect can be cached.

verified_at_runtime_in_a_browser: calculator arithmetic against an independent computation, including the zero-rate case and negative escrow inputs
the nine-panel questionnaire: per-panel required-field validation, email format, the consent gate, and the spam honeypot
the CRM payload as actually posted — no field is sent that this manifest does not declare, so nothing is silently dropped
the mobile nav panel opening, closing and toggling aria-expanded
